name: Errors
description: The errors the app and the server hit, kept on this machine: when the app stopped or a block failed, with what you were doing, and the server's own. The same error again is one line with a count; a new kind shows a toast.

keep_days.label: Days to keep
keep_days.description: how long errors are kept on this machine

notify.label: Tell me about new errors
notify.description: a toast, kept in the inbox, the first time a kind of error happens

errors.description: the errors the app and the server hit, the latest first, each kind once with a count; open one for its stack and when it happened
errors.live: this machine's error record (not in the vault)

limit.description: how many kinds of error to show

source.description: only the app's errors, or only the server's
